Job Summary
Synechron is seeking a capable and innovative GenAI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy Generative AI solutions across enterprise platforms. This role blends hands-on GenAI, NLP, and data science with cross-functional collaboration to build scalable, secure, and production-ready AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate will advance GenAI initiatives, mentor teammates, and ensure alignment with governance, risk, and compliance requirements while delivering measurable business value.

Software Requirements

Required Skills (Essential)

Hands-on experience with Generative AI and large language models (LLMs) such as OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent
Strong proficiency in Python for AI development, model integration, and data processing
Expertise with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and serverless/event-driven architectures (e.g., SageMaker + Lambda)
Proficiency with vector databases and embeddings (e.g., Faiss, Pinecone)
Knowledge of deploying AI models on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and basic MLOps concepts
Experience with AI model governance, data privacy, and security considerations in production
Familiarity with version control (Git) and collaborative development workflows
Understanding of the SDLC/ML lifecycle, experimentation, and model evaluation

Preferred

Containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) for AI services
CI/CD pipelines for AI workflows (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Harness)
Model monitoring, bias mitigation, and safety in AI systems
Integration of AI solutions with existing enterprise data pipelines and APIs

Overall Responsibilities

Design, develop, and optimize GenAI/AI-driven solutions and autonomous AI workflows
Lead implementation, deployment, and governance of AI models within CI/CD pipelines on cloud platforms
Mentor and guide junior AI engineers, promoting best practices in AI development, MLOps, and responsible AI
Identify, evaluate, and pilot new AI technologies and architectures to improve business processes
Collaborate with product, data, and platform teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions
Stay current with AI/ML trends and industry developments; translate insights into actionable plans
Ensure governance, risk, and compliance considerations are embedded in AI initiatives
Develop and maintain AI architecture, deployment guidelines, and model governance documentation
Drive continuous improvement of AI delivery, automation, and operational efficiency

Technical Skills (By Category)

Programming Languages (Essential Preferred)

Essential: Python
Preferred: R, Java, or C++ for integration or performance optimization

AI Frameworks Libraries

Essential: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers
Preferred: LangChain, SpaCy, OpenAI API usage patterns

Model Development Deployment

Essential: Training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment of LLMs; embeddings and vector-based retrieval
Preferred: Encryption layers, secure model serving, model governance practices

Cloud Infrastructure

Essential: Experience deploying AI models on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Preferred: Managed AI services (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML) and multi-cloud deployments

Data Management Storage

Essential: Vector databases and data pipelines for AI workloads; data preprocessing
Preferred: NoSQL databases and data warehousing concepts; data lineage and governance

DevOps MLOps

Essential: Version control (Git), CI/CD concepts, basic monitoring for AI pipelines
Preferred: Containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), MLOps tools, model monitoring platforms

Security Compliance

Essential: Data privacy, model security, and governance for AI deployments
Preferred: AI safety, bias detection/mitigation, auditable model governance

Experience Requirements

5+ years in AI/ML/Data Science with at least 3 years in GenAI/NLP
Proven experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (product, data science, engineering, security)
Exposure to regulated industries and governance considerations is a plus
Alternative pathways: strong portfolio of GenAI/NLP projects or relevant certifications

Day-to-Day Activities

Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy GenAI/NLP models and autonomous AI components
Collaborate with product, data, and engineering teams to identify AI use cases and success metrics
Build and maintain AI pipelines (training, inference, monitoring) in cloud environments
Evaluate new AI techniques, tools, and platforms; lead proofs-of-concept
Monitor model performance, detect drift, and implement retraining or adjustments
Maintain comprehensive documentation on model architecture, data pipelines, and deployment steps
Ensure governance, risk, and compliance considerations are integrated into AI initiatives
Mentor junior AI engineers and promote knowledge sharing

Qualifications

Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or related field
5+ years of experience in AI/ML/Data Science with at least 3 years in GenAI/NLP
Certifications in AI/ML, cloud platforms, or MLOps are advantageous

Professional Competencies

Strategic thinking and analytical problem-solving for AI applications
Clear communication and stakeholder management for technical and non-technical audiences
Leadership and teamwork with ability to mentor peers
Adaptability to evolving AI technologies and regulatory landscapes
Innovation mindset with a focus on scalable, responsible AI solutions
Time management and prioritization in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

rows.job_description:
ROLE OVERVIEW
We are looking for a hands-on Senior AI Engineer to build production-grade AI systems using Generative AI, RAG, GraphRAG , knowledge graphs, vector search, LLM orchestration and computer vision. You will work on real-world AI products across healthcare, enterprise software and data platforms, taking solutions from experimentation to production.
The ideal candidate has strong software engineering fundamentals, hands-on experience with LLMs and RAG systems, and the ability to work across AI, backend, data and cloud technologies.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


AI & GenAI Engineering
Build production-grade RAG and GraphRAG systems combining LLMs, vector search, knowledge graphs and structured data.
Develop LLM workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or equivalent frameworks.
Build AI agents, tool-calling workflows and stateful AI pipelines.
Implement embeddings, semantic search, chunking, reranking and hybrid retrieval.
Develop text-to-SQL, text-to-Cypher and natural-language query systems.
Build LLM evaluation pipelines and optimise accuracy, latency and cost.
Work with LLM APIs and batch processing using models such as OpenAI, Anthropic and other foundation models.
Knowledge Graphs & Data
Design and work with Neo4j knowledge graphs, including graph modelling and Cypher queries.
Build semantic enrichment pipelines including entity extraction, entity linking and relationship extraction.
Develop data pipelines using Apache Airflow or equivalent orchestration tools.
Work with PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant and other vector databases.
Process and index large-scale enterprise datasets for AI applications
Platform & Data Engineering
Architect multi-tenant SaaS platforms with strong data isolation across database, storage, API and orchestration layers.
Build and maintain data pipelines with Apache Airflow, including ETL, DAG orchestration, data quality checks and real-time synchronisation.
Design scalable APIs and services in Python (FastAPI) and Node.js / TypeScript, backed by PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Redis and vector stores.
Deploy and operate workloads on AWS and GCP using serverless, containerised and event-driven patterns.
Security & Compliance
Enforce HIPAA-grade controls: encryption with KMS, RBAC, JWT/OAuth authentication, audit logging and per-tenant key management.
Translate regulatory and client compliance requirements into concrete architecture and engineering standards.
Leadership & Delivery (Nice to Have)
Lead and mentor a team of 2 to 4 engineers through architecture reviews, code reviews, sprint planning and delivery milestones.
Act as the primary technical point of contact for clients: gather requirements, propose solutions, report progress and manage expectations.
Raise the bar on code quality, documentation, testing and engineering practices across the team.
REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
5+ years of software engineering experience with significant hands-on experience in AI/ML or GenAI.
Strong Python skills and experience with FastAPI .
Hands-on experience building RAG, LLM and AI agent applications .
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or equivalent.
Strong understanding of embeddings, vector search and semantic retrieval .
Experience with Qdrant, Pinecone, ChromaDB, pgvector or similar.
Experience with Neo4j and Cypher is highly desirable.
Strong PostgreSQL / SQL skills and experience with Redis.
Experience with Node.js / TypeScript ; Next.js / React is a plus.
Experience with AWS and/or GCP, Docker and CI/CD .
Strong understanding of APIs, asynchronous processing, testing and debugging.
Good communication skills and ability to independently own technical problems.
GOOD TO HAVE
Experience with LLM or vision model fine-tuning workflows, GPU-backed training and model registries.
Computer vision with PyTorch / TensorFlow, OpenCV, YOLO or U-Net.
Payment and real-time integrations such as Stripe, Razorpay, Socket.io or Pusher.
Comfort with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.
QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor s degree in Engineering (IT / Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.

Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, cloud, and platform teams to ensure high availability and reliability of AI services.

Support production deployments, operational readiness, on-call activities, and continuous reliability improvements.

68 years of overall IT experience, including hands-on experience in SRE, production support, or infrastructure operations.
Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and cloud infrastructure operations.
Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, or ELK Stack.
Experience designing, implementing, and testing disaster recovery and business continuity solutions.
Strong understanding of performance monitoring, system tuning, scalability, and capacity planning.
Proficiency in Python or Bash scripting for automation and operational tooling.
Working knowledge of Generative AI, LLM infrastructure, and the reliability challenges of AI-powered applications.
Experience in incident management, production troubleshooting, escalation management, and on-call rotations.
Strong understanding of SRE principles, high availability, fault tolerance, and production reliability best practices.

Good to Have

Experience with Kubernetes and containerized deployments for AI/ML workloads.
Exposure to chaos engineering, fault injection, and resilience testing.
Familiarity with LLM serving, inference workloads, latency monitoring, and AI platform performance optimization.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation) and CI/CD pipelines.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Candidates with strong AWS, SRE, production operations, observability, disaster recovery, and automation experience, along with exposure to GenAI/LLM platforms, are encouraged to apply.

Keywords: GenAI SRE Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, AWS SRE, Generative AI, LLM Infrastructure, Cloud Operations, Production Support, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Python, Bash, Kubernetes, Disaster Recovery, Incident Management, SLI, SLO, SLA.

You will:
Run Technology on clear weekly priorities with an owner, deadline and measurable outcome for every major initiative.
Establish strong engineering execution across product development, integrations, automation, infrastructure and AI.
Track commitments through completion - not merely development activity.
Identify blockers early and make fast build/buy/outsource decisions.
Hold internal teams and external partners accountable for scope, timelines, quality and business outcomes.
Build clear visibility from:
Business Requirement Development Production Adoption Business Impact
Develop engineers and technology managers into stronger owners and future leaders.
Create sufficient documentation, architecture standards and ownership so no critical system depends on one employee or vendor.
Success means:
Leadership should never need to repeatedly ask, Where is this project stuck and who owns it

Technology exists to improve business outcomes.
You will:
Deeply understand how Ergode makes money across marketplaces, brands and channels.

Own the Technology AI roadmap based on impact on:
Revenue
Gross margin
Productivity
Operating cost
Speed
Customer/vendor experience

Challenge processes that should be eliminated or simplified before automating them.
Translate business problems into scalable technology solutions.
Own technology economics including cloud, AI/token usage, software licences, development and outsourcing.
Report technology performance to leadership in business outcomes rather than project activity .

AI is not an innovation project at Ergode. It is becoming part of how the company operates.
You will:
Identify high-volume and high-value manual work suitable for AI or automation.
Build and deploy AI agents and GenAI workflows into real production environments .
Develop reusable AI architecture rather than disconnected experiments.
Integrate AI into areas including:
Catalogue and content
Marketplace listings
Pricing
Inventory
Customer support
Sales
Finance
HR
Reporting and decision support

Measure:
hours/FTE capacity saved
cycle-time reduction
cost reduction
quality improvement
revenue/margin impact
user adoption
Kill pilots that do not produce value and scale the ones that do.
Ensure business teams actually adopt what Technology builds.
We are not looking for:

We are looking for:
Someone who has put AI into production and can show what changed because of it.




4. E-commerce Platforms Marketplace Technology
Our technology must support a complex global marketplace operation.
You will own and strengthen:
Marketplace integrations including Amazon SP-API, Walmart, eBay and other channels.
Catalogue and listing infrastructure.
Pricing and quantity synchronization.
Order processing.
Inventory and warehouse integrations.
Returns, refunds and reconciliation workflows.
Marketplace reporting and operational intelligence.
API reliability and monitoring.

The goal is reliable commerce at scale .




5. Product Platform Ownership
You will take ownership of Ergode s core internal technology platforms and ensure they become dependable business systems.
This includes:
evaluating existing architecture,
identifying technical debt,
establishing clear module ownership,
improving reliability and usability,
prioritising development based on business value,
and driving adoption after launch.
Technology is not complete when code is deployed.
A feature is complete when the business can reliably use it and the expected outcome is visible.




6. Data Foundation Decision Intelligence
AI is only as strong as the underlying data.
You will:
Build reliable data flows across business systems.
Establish clear sources of truth for critical business information.
Reduce duplicate datasets and manual reconciliation.
Improve data quality and ownership.
Enable dashboards and AI systems to consume trustworthy business data.
Build APIs and integration layers that allow new agents and applications to be deployed quickly.




7. Architecture, Cloud Engineering Quality
You should be technically strong enough to challenge architecture and engineering decisions yourself.
You will:
Review architecture for scalability, reliability, maintainability, security and cost.
Establish coding, testing, documentation and deployment standards.
Strengthen CI/CD and monitoring.
Review estimates rather than blindly accepting them.
Prototype when speed requires it.
Make pragmatic technology choices rather than over-engineering.
We expect a leader who can move comfortably between a CEO conversation about ROI and an engineering conversation about architecture.




8. Security, Reliability AI Governance
You will own the reliability and security of Ergode s technology environment.
Responsibilities include:
Cloud and infrastructure reliability
Monitoring and uptime
Incident management
Root-cause analysis
Backups and disaster recovery
Identity and access management
SSO
Endpoint/device security
Data protection
You will also establish practical AI governance covering:
which company information can be shared with which AI systems,
permissions available to AI agents,
human review requirements for critical decisions,
auditability,
and acceptable AI use.
Compliance should appropriately address DPDP and relevant international privacy/security requirements.




9. Build vs Buy vs Outsource
We do not believe everything must be built internally.
We do believe Ergode must own the outcome.
You will decide when to:
BUILD - when capability creates strategic advantage.
BUY - when a reliable product already solves the problem economically.
OUTSOURCE - when an external specialist can deliver faster.
For outsourced work, you will own:
requirements,
architecture,
vendor selection,
commercial evaluation,
milestones,
SLAs,
quality,
security,
source code,
documentation,
handover.
No critical Ergode technology should become permanently dependent on one vendor or individual.
